name: Dragonkin
heading: Dragonkin Traits and the five subrace entries
sourceDistinctions: The 2015 Open Design original has four elemental kinds and the mixed-heritage Edjet option in one player profile.
Karrash uses Flame. The profile is distinct from the core Dragonborn ancestry and the Pathfinder Advanced Races printing.

name: Shadow Fey
heading: Shadow Fey and Shadow Fey Traits
sourceDistinctions: Midgard Heroes (2015) is the original booklet, distinct from the 2018 Midgard Heroes Handbook. The 2015 Traveler in Darkness text covers both fey roads and shadow roads.
The source calls this an elf subrace and uses the 2014 elf base traits. The catalog recognizes Shadow Fey as its own exact publication entry.
Shade and Shadar-kai refer to separate playable profiles.

name: Dust Goblin
heading: Dust Goblin, Dust Goblin Traits and Twisted continuation
sourceDistinctions: This is the 2016 player ancestry. Group it under Goblin while keeping its own playable version and edition link.
Twisted uses the attack trigger, so Kethrek applies the save even when the attack misses. The trait has no printed use limit.
The 2014 duplicate proficiency rule lets Kethrek replace the overlap between racial Survival and background Survival with Nature.

name: Sahuagin
heading: Sahuagin and Sahuagin Traits
sourceDistinctions: Use the player character entry. Sea devil names this species. The player frenzy spends a bonus action and has a long-rest limit.
Vekatal is a standard two-armed Sahuagin with legs. The book discusses malenti and other mutations without granting them separate player trait packages here.
The natural attack entry provides a damage die. Vekatal applies the standard melee Strength modifier. AC uses the natural formula and a shield.
